en.text: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華曉諭摩西說：

en.text: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

zhSimplified.text: 「你要吩咐以色列人说：『献给我的供物，就是献给我作馨香火祭的食物，你们要按日期献给我』；

zhTraditional.text: 「你要吩咐以色列人說：『獻給我的供物，就是獻給我作馨香火祭的食物，你們要按日期獻給我』；

en.text: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

zhSimplified.text: 又要对他们说：你们要献给耶和华的火祭，就是没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，每日两只，作为常献的燔祭。

zhTraditional.text: 又要對他們說：你們要獻給耶和華的火祭，就是沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，每日兩隻，作為常獻的燔祭。

en.text: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

zhSimplified.text: 早晨要献一只，黄昏的时候要献一只；

zhTraditional.text: 早晨要獻一隻，黃昏的時候要獻一隻；

en.text: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

footnotes.text: 28:5 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel
28:5 A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons.

zhSimplified.text: 又用细面伊法十分之一，并捣成的油一欣四分之一，调和作为素祭。

zhTraditional.text: 又用細麵伊法十分之一，並搗成的油一欣四分之一，調和作為素祭。

en.text: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 这是西奈山所命定为常献的燔祭，是献给耶和华为馨香的火祭。

zhTraditional.text: 這是西奈山所命定為常獻的燔祭，是獻給耶和華為馨香的火祭。

en.text: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

footnotes.text: 28:7 One hin is about 6.5 liters, so 1/4 hin is about 1.6 liters or 1.7 quarts.

zhSimplified.text: 为这一只羊羔，要同献奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在圣所中，你要将醇酒奉给耶和华为奠祭。

zhTraditional.text: 為這一隻羊羔，要同獻奠祭的酒一欣四分之一。在聖所中，你要將醇酒奉給耶和華為奠祭。

en.text: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 晚上，你要献那一只羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同献的奠祭献上，作为馨香的火祭，献给耶和华。」

zhTraditional.text: 晚上，你要獻那一隻羊羔，必照早晨的素祭和同獻的奠祭獻上，作為馨香的火祭，獻給耶和華。」

en.text: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

footnotes.text: 28:9 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

zhSimplified.text: 「当安息日，要献两只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，并用调油的细面伊法十分之二为素祭，又将同献的奠祭献上。

zhTraditional.text: 「當安息日，要獻兩隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，並用調油的細麵伊法十分之二為素祭，又將同獻的奠祭獻上。

en.text: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

zhSimplified.text: 这是每安息日献的燔祭；那常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭在外。」

zhTraditional.text: 這是每安息日獻的燔祭；那常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭在外。」

en.text: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

zhSimplified.text: 「每月朔，你们要将两只公牛犊，一只公绵羊，七只没有残疾、一岁的公羊羔，献给耶和华为燔祭。

zhTraditional.text: 「每月朔，你們要將兩隻公牛犢，一隻公綿羊，七隻沒有殘疾、一歲的公羊羔，獻給耶和華為燔祭。

en.text: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

footnotes.text: 28:12 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel

zhSimplified.text: 每只公牛要用调油的细面伊法十分之三作为素祭；那只公羊也用调油的细面伊法十分之二作为素祭；

zhTraditional.text: 每隻公牛要用調油的細麵伊法十分之三作為素祭；那隻公羊也用調油的細麵伊法十分之二作為素祭；

en.text: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 每只羊羔要用调油的细面伊法十分之一作为素祭和馨香的燔祭，是献给耶和华的火祭。

zhTraditional.text: 每隻羊羔要用調油的細麵伊法十分之一作為素祭和馨香的燔祭，是獻給耶和華的火祭。

en.text: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

zhSimplified.text: 一只公牛要奠酒半欣，一只公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一只羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。这是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。

zhTraditional.text: 一隻公牛要奠酒半欣，一隻公羊要奠酒一欣三分之一，一隻羊羔也奠酒一欣四分之一。這是每月的燔祭，一年之中要月月如此。

en.text: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

zhSimplified.text: 又要将一只公山羊为赎罪祭，献给耶和华；要献在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。」 （利23·5—14）

zhTraditional.text: 又要將一隻公山羊為贖罪祭，獻給耶和華；要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。」 （利23‧5－14）

en.text: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.

zhSimplified.text: 「正月十四日是耶和华的逾越节。

zhTraditional.text: 「正月十四日是耶和華的逾越節。

en.text: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

zhSimplified.text: 这月十五日是节期，要吃无酵饼七日。

zhTraditional.text: 這月十五日是節期，要吃無酵餅七日。

en.text: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

zhSimplified.text: 第一日当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。

zhTraditional.text: 第一日當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。

en.text: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

zhSimplified.text: 当将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，都要没有残疾的，用火献给耶和华为燔祭。

zhTraditional.text: 當將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，都要沒有殘疾的，用火獻給耶和華為燔祭。

en.text: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

zhSimplified.text: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为一只公牛要献伊法十分之三；为一只公羊要献伊法十分之二；

zhTraditional.text: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為一隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二；

en.text: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

zhSimplified.text: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献伊法十分之一。

zhTraditional.text: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。

en.text: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

zhSimplified.text: 并献一只公山羊作赎罪祭，为你们赎罪。

zhTraditional.text: 並獻一隻公山羊作贖罪祭，為你們贖罪。

en.text: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

zhSimplified.text: 你们献这些，要在早晨常献的燔祭以外。

zhTraditional.text: 你們獻這些，要在早晨常獻的燔祭以外。

en.text: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

zhSimplified.text: 一连七日，每日要照这例把馨香火祭的食物献给耶和华，是在常献的燔祭和同献的奠祭以外。

zhTraditional.text: 一連七日，每日要照這例把馨香火祭的食物獻給耶和華，是在常獻的燔祭和同獻的奠祭以外。

en.text: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

zhSimplified.text: 第七日当有圣会，什么劳碌的工都不可做。」 （利23·15—22）

zhTraditional.text: 第七日當有聖會，甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。」 （利23‧15－22）

en.text: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

zhSimplified.text: 「七七节庄稼初熟，你们献新素祭给耶和华的日子，当有圣会；什么劳碌的工都不可做。

zhTraditional.text: 「七七節莊稼初熟，你們獻新素祭給耶和華的日子，當有聖會；甚麼勞碌的工都不可做。

en.text: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

zhSimplified.text: 只要将公牛犊两只，公绵羊一只，一岁的公羊羔七只，作为馨香的燔祭献给耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 只要將公牛犢兩隻，公綿羊一隻，一歲的公羊羔七隻，作為馨香的燔祭獻給耶和華。

en.text: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

zhSimplified.text: 同献的素祭用调油的细面；为每只公牛要献伊法十分之三；为一只公羊要献伊法十分之二；

zhTraditional.text: 同獻的素祭用調油的細麵；為每隻公牛要獻伊法十分之三；為一隻公羊要獻伊法十分之二；

en.text: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

zhSimplified.text: 为那七只羊羔，每只要献伊法十分之一。

zhTraditional.text: 為那七隻羊羔，每隻要獻伊法十分之一。

en.text: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

zhSimplified.text: 并献一只公山羊为你们赎罪。

zhTraditional.text: 並獻一隻公山羊為你們贖罪。

en.text: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

zhSimplified.text: 这些，你们要献在常献的燔祭和同献的素祭并同献的奠祭以外，都要没有残疾的。」

zhTraditional.text: 這些，你們要獻在常獻的燔祭和同獻的素祭並同獻的奠祭以外，都要沒有殘疾的。」
